text.fr: L'amour est la prise de conscience extrêmement difficile que quelque chose d'autre que soi est réel.
text.en: Love is the extremely difficult realisation that something other than oneself is real.

source.fr: « The Sublime and the Good », Chicago Review, vol. 13, n° 3 (1959), p. 51
source.en: "The Sublime and the Good", Chicago Review, vol. 13, no. 3 (1959), p. 51

context.en: French translation by Philoscopia; the English is the original text.
